question: Which award did Armando Colaco receive in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dronacharya Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Armando Colaco**, the legendary Indian football coach, was conferred with the prestigious **Dronacharya Award** in **January 2025** for his outstanding and life-long contribution to sports coaching in **India**.
 
• He is widely recognized as one of the most successful managers in the history of Indian domestic football, specifically for his transformative era with the **Goan** club **Dempo SC**.
 
• Under his guidance, **Dempo SC** won the **I-League** title five times (including the **National Football League** era), making them one of the most dominant forces in **Indian football** during the **2000s**.
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is presented by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** to coaches who have demonstrated excellence in training athletes and teams to achieve international success.
